note: What the published control catalogue says ABOUT each control beyond its bounds and prose: whether it is open, pinned or inert, which controls the world's physical width derives, and which producers honour it. The reference derived these in tools/export_controls.py (source_identity) into world_controls.json (reference_catalogue_identity); tools/embed/controls.py derives them the same way from world-options.json + config-controls.json + this file, so the catalogue is generated, not copied. `status` is `pinned` when min == max, `inert` when named here, `open` otherwise. `derived` is in the order the width derivation runs in src/config.cpp resolve(): shape_overrides' five, the three reaches, then the catalogue area; tests/test_controls.cpp checks each one actually moves with circumference_km and yields to an explicit override. PRODUCERS CHANGED MEANING: in the reference, `native` meant its old Core/ resolver, which honoured 24 controls. Here `native` is this producer, which routes all 209 through `--request` (tests pin that every catalogue name is accepted); `reference` still means the Python producer, which published all 209. The INERT reason is rewritten for this producer: the reference's text named a Python function.
derived_note: Computed from the world's physical width unless set explicitly; an explicit value wins. An absent circumference_km falls back to the world_size preset, so this derives on the default path too.

inert.stubbornness: Stored on Config and written to the world document's config block, and read by no generation stage: the automatic-parameter path that consumed it is retired, and recipe 3 forbids auto_parameters. The value is accepted and changes nothing.

reference_inert.stubbornness: Written only by terrain_recipes.seed_config, which runs when auto_parameters is set; recipe 3 forbids auto_parameters, so on this recipe the value is accepted and never read.
